Localization.Value: Direct the slime to the portal of the appropriate color
The hourglass adds a minute to the timer
The slime will sleep until the specified number of the slimes are catched in the portals
The travelator changes direction of the movement of the slime
The lightning makes the travelators controllable by clicking on them
The lucky block will destroy after the specified number of slime hits it and will give you bonus coins
The hammer destroys all the lucky blocks. It increases the amount of coins you receive or gives you a chance to get a random bonus
